title: Agency Ads & LSA: the manager page

steps.caption: Agency Ads & LSA manager
steps.narration: This is the Agency Ads and LSA manager: every client account under your Google Ads MCC, in one place.

steps.caption: Agency connection
steps.narration: Agency connection shows the connected manager account, and that it is verified.

steps.caption: The sections
steps.narration: The sections are on the left: Client accounts, Access invitations, Protection previews, Queue and Health audit.

steps.caption: Client accounts
steps.narration: Client accounts lists each account under the MCC.

steps.caption: One client account
steps.narration: A row shows the status, currency, timezone, whether Local Services campaigns were found, and when it was last checked.

steps.caption: Queue health audit
steps.narration: Tick accounts and choose Queue health audit. The audit only reads; nothing in Google changes.

steps.caption: Health audit
steps.narration: Health audit lists each finding by account.

steps.caption: A finding and its fix
steps.narration: Each finding has a severity and a way to fix it, like Edit schedule preview.

steps.caption: Protection previews
steps.narration: Protection previews holds one preview per account.

steps.caption: Ready for review
steps.narration: This one blocks seven IPs on two campaigns, and is Ready for review.

steps.caption: Confirm only after review
steps.narration: Nothing is written to Google until you tick that you reviewed the previews and confirm.

steps.caption: Queue
steps.narration: Queue shows the audits, previews and applies as they run.

steps.caption: A finished job
steps.narration: Each job shows its account, its kind and whether it is done.

steps.caption: Menu: Agency
steps.narration: You'll find it in the Google Ads tool, under Agency on the left.

youtube.title: Agency Ads & LSA manager: the page in a minute | ConstructHUB
youtube.description: A tour of the Agency Ads & LSA manager page in ConstructHUB: the connected MCC, the client account list, the read-only health audit, the protection previews that wait for your confirmation, and the queue of jobs. For agencies that run Google Ads for contractors.
